correctness.rationale: Plancherel for P^3 on the probability torus, with support among signed coordinate triples, gives exactly F=6-9Σs_j²+4Σs_j³+Σ(18-12s_j)|q_j|²+36Σ_{i<j}(2-s_i-s_j)Re(q_i conj(q_j)), normalized S=1. The inequalities |q_j|<=s_j/2 and Re(q_i conj(q_j))<=s_i s_j/4 give the scalar profile G(s)=15-(45/2)Σs_j²+10Σs_j³. The identity C_d-G(s)=Σ(s_j-1/d)²(45/2-10s_j-20/d) is nonnegative, with positive coefficients d>=2, and the separate within-pair and phase terms form the claimed exact positive deficit. Equality forces uniform s_j, balanced |a_j|=|b_j|, and common product phases; d=1 is handled separately. Fourier cubic support lies in [-3,3]^d so no alias for finite cyclic orders>=7; at order6 the ±3e_j frequencies merge and create exactly 1/(4d²) excess for uniform equal coefficients. An independent Gaussian-integer triple convolution rederived the polynomial moment for 35 random test configurations in each d=1..5 and checked sharp/extremal and finite-modulus boundary cases. This is an exact all-d proof, not an inference from numerical samples.
